camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeLogMeta --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '123.168.XX.XX' --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1276085894170000 --Lang zh --From sas
description_en: Queries the configuration information of log analysis in Security Center
description_zh: 查询云安全中心日志分析的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-log-meta --source-ip 123.168.XX.XX --lang zh --from sas --resource-directory-account-id 1276085894170000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLogMeta

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The source identifier of the request. Default value: aegis. Valid values:

aegis: Server Guard edition.
sas: Security Center edition.

Server Guard users should use aegis, and Security Center users should use sas
parameters.help_zh:
请求来源标识，默认aegis，取值：

aegis：安骑士版本。
sas：云安全中心版本。

安骑士用户请使用aegis，云安全中心用户则使用sas
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

LogMetaList.description_en: The list of log analysis configurations in Security Center
LogMetaList.description_zh: 云安全中心日志分析的配置信息列表

items.description_en: The log analysis configuration information in Security Center
items.description_zh: 云安全中心日志分析的配置信息

Category.description_en:
The log category. Valid values:

host: Host logs.
security: Security logs
Category.description_zh:
日志分类。取值：

host：主机日志。
security：安全日志

HotTtl.description_en:
The number of days before hot storage data is converted to cold storage. Unit: days.


A value of -1 indicates that no conversion is performed
HotTtl.description_zh:
热存储转冷存储时间。单位：天。


若为-1表示不进行转换

LogDesc.description_en: The name of the log type

LogStore.description_en: The name of the dedicated Logstore where logs are stored

Status.description_en:
The current status. Valid values:
disabled: Disabled.
enabled: Enabled
Status.description_zh:
当前启用状态。取值：
disabled：未启用。
enabled：启用

Topic.description_en: The topic of the delivered logs

Ttl.description_en: The log retention period, in days

UserLogStore.description_en: The name of the dedicated Logstore where user logs are stored
UserLogStore.description_zh: 用户日志存放的专属Logstore名称

UserProject.description_en: The name of the dedicated Project where logs are stored

UserRegion.description_en: The region to which the logs belong

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of configuration entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的配置信息总数量
